accepted_manuscript.name: original authored manuscript before publication-only edits

claim: For every field k of characteristic zero and every nonzero h in k[x], the canonical ordinary Hochschild Gerstenhaber algebra of A_h admits a BV generator if and only if gcd(h,hprime)=1. For repeated factors there is no degree-minus-one generator even without square-zero.
source_inputs: Lopes–Solotar section 3 and Corollary 3.11: length-two free bimodule resolution, HH0=k, HH2=A/dA, higher HH zero.
Lopes–Solotar section 6.1: D_f inner iff h divides f.
Lopes–Solotar Theorem 6.2(b,c): Lie center and abelianness when d=1.
independent_checks: Normalized bar comparison and all-derivation cup formula.
Central cup annihilator forces Delta on HH1 to vanish.
Explicit derivation b, cup-zero pair, nonzero outer commutator.
Nonsplit fields, nonmonic h, constant h, excluded h=0 ambiguity, Nakayama Jordan block.
limits: Acceptance is an independent mathematical audit, not peer review or a formal proof-assistant certification.
No assertion of historical priority or novelty is certified.
Source-recovery later-resolution search is bounded and does not prove the question remained open.
Scope excludes zero h, positive characteristic, unrelated brackets, and twisted or invariant Hochschild replacements.
publication_note: Receipt accepts the original manuscript hash. PUBLICATION_PROVENANCE.json maps publication-only edits; this is not a new mathematical acceptance claim.
